## Sanity check: when were pings sent and filled out?

`ping_sent_time` (from the emapingbot export) and `ping_time` (Qualtrics RecordedDate, i.e.
when the survey was submitted) are both in UTC. Converted to each participant's own time
zone, pings should have been sent within the 9am-9pm windows, and every response should
be submitted after its ping was sent. Responses must have been *started* within 1 hour
of the ping (see processing.Rmd), so submission can run a bit past 60 minutes.

```{r}
participant_tz <- read_csv("../data/kpetrova_export/kpetrova_participants.csv",
                           col_types = cols(study_pid = "c")) |>
  filter(study_id == 30, str_detect(study_pid, "^\\d+$")) |>
  distinct(PID = as.numeric(study_pid), tz)

local_hour <- function(t, tz) map2_dbl(t, tz, \(t, tz) {
  lt <- with_tz(t, tz)
  hour(lt) + minute(lt) / 60 + second(lt) / 3600
})

ping_timing <- data |>
  select(PID, DAY_NUM, PING_NUM, ping_sent_time, ping_time) |>
  left_join(participant_tz, by = "PID") |>
  mutate(
    sent_hour_local   = local_hour(ping_sent_time, tz),
    filled_hour_local = local_hour(ping_time, tz),
    window = cut(sent_hour_local, breaks = c(9, 12, 15, 18, 21), right = FALSE,
                 labels = c("9-12", "12-3", "3-6", "6-9")),
    minutes_to_complete = as.numeric(difftime(ping_time, ping_sent_time, units = "mins"))
  )

hhmm <- function(h) {
  m <- round(h * 60)
  sprintf("%02d:%02d", m %/% 60, m %% 60)
}

# overall: study date range, time of day, and time from ping to submission
ping_timing |>
  summarise(
    n_responses        = n(),
    missing_tz         = sum(is.na(tz)),
    first_ping_sent    = min(ping_sent_time),
    last_ping_sent     = max(ping_sent_time),
    first_filled       = min(ping_time),
    last_filled        = max(ping_time),
    earliest_sent_tod  = hhmm(min(sent_hour_local)),
    latest_sent_tod    = hhmm(max(sent_hour_local)),
    earliest_filled_tod = hhmm(min(filled_hour_local)),
    latest_filled_tod  = hhmm(max(filled_hour_local)),
    min_minutes_to_complete = min(minutes_to_complete),
    max_minutes_to_complete = max(minutes_to_complete),
    n_filled_before_sent    = sum(minutes_to_complete < 0)
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), values_transform = as.character)

# by ping window (local time of day)
ping_timing |>
  group_by(window) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    earliest_sent   = hhmm(min(sent_hour_local)),
    latest_sent     = hhmm(max(sent_hour_local)),
    earliest_filled = hhmm(min(filled_hour_local)),
    latest_filled   = hhmm(max(filled_hour_local)),
    median_minutes_to_complete = median(minutes_to_complete),
    max_minutes_to_complete    = max(minutes_to_complete),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# by participant
ping_timing |>
  group_by(PID, tz) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    first_filled = min(ping_time),
    last_filled  = max(ping_time),
    study_days   = as.numeric(difftime(last_filled, first_filled, units = "days")),
    earliest_filled_tod = hhmm(min(filled_hour_local)),
    latest_filled_tod   = hhmm(max(filled_hour_local)),
    max_minutes_to_complete = max(minutes_to_complete),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(max_minutes_to_complete))

ping_timing |>
  pivot_longer(c(sent_hour_local, filled_hour_local), names_to = "event", values_to = "hour") |>
  mutate(event = recode(event, sent_hour_local = "Ping sent", filled_hour_local = "Survey submitted")) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = hour)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.25, boundary = 0) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(9, 12, 15, 18, 21), linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 24, 3)) +
  facet_wrap(~event, ncol = 1) +
  labs(x = "Local time of day (hour)", y = "Count")

ggplot(ping_timing, aes(x = minutes_to_complete)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 5, boundary = 0) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 60, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(x = "Minutes from ping sent to survey submitted", y = "Count")
```

# Frisem talk
```{r}
time_summary <- data |>
  arrange(PID, regret_id, ping_time) |>
  group_by(PID, regret_id) |>
  mutate(time_diff_min = as.numeric(
      difftime(ping_time, lag(ping_time), units = "mins"))) |>
  mutate(time_diff_min = case_when(followup_id == 1 ~ 0, TRUE ~ time_diff_min)) %>% 
    summarise(
    start_time = min(ping_time, na.rm = TRUE),
    end_time   = max(ping_time, na.rm = TRUE),
    duration_min = as.numeric(difftime(end_time, start_time, units = "mins")),
    n_pings = n(),
    n_followups = sum(followup_id > 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(duration_min < 10080) |>
  filter(!is.na(regret_id))
  
participant_summary <- time_summary %>%
  group_by(PID) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_duration = mean(duration_min, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_duration   = sd(duration_min, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_followups = mean(n_followups, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_regrets = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
  
```

```{r}
ggplot(time_summary, aes(x = duration_min)) +
```

```{r}
pid_to_plot <- "112234"

# 1) Episode-level start/end for one participant
one_pid <- data %>%
  filter(!is.na(regret_id)) |>
  mutate(
    ping_time = ymd_hms(ping_time, tz = "UTC"),
    ping_time = with_tz(ping_time, "America/Los_Angeles")
  ) %>%
  filter(PID == pid_to_plot) %>%
  arrange(regret_id, ping_time) %>%
  group_by(regret_id) %>%
  summarise(
    start_time = min(ping_time, na.rm = TRUE),
    end_time   = max(ping_time, na.rm = TRUE),
    duration_min = as.numeric(difftime(end_time, start_time, units = "mins")),
    duration_hr = duration_min / 60,
    n_pings = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 2) Build "night" rectangles covering the full window
# Define night as 22:00 -> 06:00 (spans midnight)
night_start_hour <- 23
night_end_hour   <- 9

start_day <- floor_date(min(one_pid$start_time), unit = "day")
end_day   <- ceiling_date(max(one_pid$end_time), unit = "day")

days <- seq.Date(as.Date(start_day), as.Date(end_day), by = "day")

night_df <- tibble(day = days) %>%
  mutate(
    night_start = as.POSIXct(day, tz = "America/Los_Angeles") + hours(night_start_hour),
    night_end   = as.POSIXct(day + days(1), tz = "America/Los_Angeles") + hours(night_end_hour)
  )

# 3) Plot: night shading + regret episode segments
ggplot() +
  geom_rect(
    data = night_df,
    aes(xmin = night_start, xmax = night_end, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    alpha = 0.12
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = one_pid,
    aes(
      x = start_time,
      xend = end_time,
      y = 1,
      yend = 1,
      color = duration_hr
    ),
    linewidth = 6,
    lineend = "round",
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = 1,
    labels = NULL,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.1, 0.1))
  ) +
  scale_x_datetime(date_breaks = "1 day", date_labels = "%b %d") +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "magma", end = 0.8, name = "Duration (hr)") +
  labs(
    title = paste("Timeline of daily regrets", pid_to_plot),
    x = "Date",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_pubclean()
```

```{r}
pid_to_plot <- "101419"

raw_pid <- data %>%
  filter(!is.na(regret_id), PID == pid_to_plot) %>%
  mutate(ping_time = with_tz(ping_time, "America/Los_Angeles")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ping_time)) %>%
  arrange(regret_id, ping_time)

stopifnot(nrow(raw_pid) > 0)

# Episode bounds (for gray boxes)
episodes <- raw_pid %>%
  group_by(regret_id) %>%
  summarise(
    start_time = min(ping_time, na.rm = TRUE),
    end_time   = max(ping_time, na.rm = TRUE),
    duration_hr = as.numeric(difftime(end_time, start_time, units = "hours")),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Make follow-ups sit "within" the box vertically (so they don't overlap perfectly)
# If you have followup_id already:
raw_pid <- raw_pid %>%
  group_by(regret_id) %>%
  mutate(
    followup_rank = if ("followup_id" %in% names(.)) followup_id else row_number(),
    y_in_box = scales::rescale(followup_rank, to = c(0.955, 1.045), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Night shading (22:00 -> 06:00)
night_start_hour <- 22
night_end_hour   <- 6

start_day <- floor_date(min(raw_pid$ping_time), unit = "day")
end_day   <- ceiling_date(max(raw_pid$ping_time), unit = "day")
days <- seq.Date(as.Date(start_day), as.Date(end_day), by = "day")

night_df <- tibble(day = days) %>%
  mutate(
    night_start = as.POSIXct(day, tz = "America/Los_Angeles") + hours(night_start_hour),
    night_end   = as.POSIXct(day + days(1), tz = "America/Los_Angeles") + hours(night_end_hour)
  )

box_half_height <- 0.06  # increase for "wider" boxes

ggplot() +
  geom_rect(
    data = night_df,
    aes(xmin = night_start, xmax = night_end, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    alpha = 0.12
  ) +
  # Gray episode boxes
  geom_rect(
    data = episodes,
    aes(
      xmin = start_time,
      xmax = end_time,
      ymin = 1 - box_half_height,
      ymax = 1 + box_half_height
    ),
    fill = "grey60",
    alpha = 0.35,
    color = NA
  ) +
  # Follow-up points within each box (optionally color by followup_id/rank)
  geom_point(
    data = raw_pid,
    aes(
      x = ping_time,
      y = y_in_box,
      shape = followup_rank == 1
    ),
    size = 2.2,
    alpha = 0.9,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 16, `FALSE` = 1), guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = 1,
    labels = pid_to_plot,
    limits = c(1 - (box_half_height + 0.08), 1 + (box_half_height + 0.08)),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.1, 0.1))
  ) +
  scale_x_datetime(date_breaks = "1 week", date_labels = "%b %d") +
  labs(
    title = paste("Regret episodes with follow-ups:", pid_to_plot),
    x = "Date",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank()
  )
```

## Regret frequency, duration

```{r}
data |>
  mutate(isregret = ifelse(!is.na(regret_id), 1, 0)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = isregret)) +
  geom_bar() +
  labs(x = "Regret reported?", y = "Count") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes")) 
  
```

```{r}
data |>
  select(PID, regret_count) |>
  distinct() |>
  ggplot(aes(x = regret_count)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1) +
  labs(x = "Number of regrets reported", y = "Count") +

  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = median(regret_count, na.rm = TRUE)), color = "black", linetype = "dashed") 

data |>
  select(PID, regret_count) |>
  distinct() |>
  # number of PIDs with regret_coount == 0
  summarise(n = sum(regret_count == 0, na.rm = TRUE)) 
  
```

```{r}
data |>
```

### Intensity over time

```{r}
data |>
  group_by(PID, regret_id) |>
  mutate(mean_intensity = mean(regret_intensity, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  mutate(pmc_intensity = regret_intensity - mean_intensity) |>
  ungroup() |>
  group_by(PID, regret_id) |>
  mutate(followup_percent = (followup_id - 1) / (max(followup_id, na.rm = TRUE) - 1)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(PID, regret_id, followup_id, pmc_intensity, followup_percent) |>
  ungroup() |>
  ggplot(aes(x = followup_percent, y = pmc_intensity)) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(w = 0.025)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
  labs(x = "Time from event onset to resolution", y = "Regret intensity") +
  stat_cor(method = "pearson")
```

Same thing in absolute time: hours since the episode's first ping, and hours as a
proportion of the episode's total duration (rather than the proportion of follow-ups).

```{r}
intensity_abs <- data |>
  filter(!is.na(regret_id)) |>
  group_by(PID, regret_id) |>
  mutate(
    pmc_intensity     = regret_intensity - mean(regret_intensity, na.rm = TRUE),
    hours_since_onset = as.numeric(difftime(ping_time, min(ping_time), units = "hours")),
    duration_hrs      = max(hours_since_onset),
    time_percent      = hours_since_onset / duration_hrs
  ) |>
  ungroup()

intensity_abs |>
  filter(duration_hrs > 0) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = time_percent, y = pmc_intensity)) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(w = 0.025)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
  labs(x = "Elapsed time from event onset to resolution (proportion of episode duration)",
       y = "Regret intensity") +
  stat_cor(method = "pearson")

intensity_abs |>
  filter(duration_hrs > 0) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = hours_since_onset, y = regret_intensity)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = interaction(PID, regret_id)), alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess") +
  scale_x_continuous(trans = "log1p", breaks = c(0, 1, 3, 6, 12, 24, 48, 96, 168)) +
  labs(x = "Hours since episode onset (log scale)", y = "Regret intensity")

# does intensity decline with follow-up number vs. with elapsed time?
intensity_models <- intensity_abs |> filter(!is.na(regret_intensity))
tab_model(
  lmer(regret_intensity ~ I(followup_id - 1) + (1 | PID), data = intensity_models),
  lmer(regret_intensity ~ I(hours_since_onset / 24) + (1 | PID), data = intensity_models),
  dv.labels = c("Follow-up number", "Days since onset")
)
```

## Single participant trajectories

```{r}
data |>
  filter(regret_count > 0) |>
  filter(PID == 112204) |> # selecting a single PID to look at in more depth
  ggplot(aes(x = followup_id, y = regret_intensity, group = regret_id, color = factor(regret_id), fill = factor(regret_id))) +

```

```{r}
# function to plot each participant individually
plot_participant_trajectories <- function(data, pid) {
  p <- data %>%
    filter(PID == pid, regret_count > 0) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = followup_id, y = regret_intensity, group = regret_id, color = factor(regret_id))) +
    stat_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, span = 0.1) +
    geom_point() +
    ylim(0, 100) +
    scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set3") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1, 26, by = 5), limits = c(1, 26)) +
    labs(title = paste("PID", pid), x = "Follow-up ID", y = "Regret intensity") +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
  return(p)
}

# plot 
p_list <- lapply(unique(data$PID), function(pid) plot_participant_trajectories(data, pid))

# save plots as pdfs, 6 per page
pdf("../figures/participant_trajectories.pdf", width = 11, height = 8.5)
for (i in seq(1, length(p_list), by = 6)) {
  gridExtra::grid.arrange(grobs = p_list[i:min(i+5, length(p_list))], ncol = 2)
}
```

## Strategies

```{r}
library(forcats)

data |>
  select(-(er_otherreg_text)) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("er_"), names_to = "strategy", values_to = "value") |>
  filter(!is.na(regret_id)) |>
  filter(value == 1) |>
  mutate(strategy = case_when(
    strategy == "er_accept"   ~ "Acceptance",
    strategy == "er_distract" ~ "Distraction",
    strategy == "er_otherreg" ~ "Other",
    strategy == "er_pleasure" ~ "Pleasure-seeking",
    strategy == "er_reapp"    ~ "Reappraisal",
    strategy == "er_sitmod"   ~ "Situation modification",
    strategy == "er_socsupp"  ~ "Social support"
  )) |>
  count(strategy) |>
  mutate(strategy = fct_reorder(strategy, n)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = strategy, y = n)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = strategy), width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = scales::comma(n)),
    hjust = -0.15, size = 3.5, color = "#52514e"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12)),
    labels = scales::comma
  ) +
  coord_flip(clip = "off") +
  labs(
    title = "Emotion regulation after a regrettable decision",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "#e1e0d9", linewidth = 0.3),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "#0b0b0b", size = 11),
    axis.text.x = element_text(color = "#898781"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(color = "#52514e"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, color = "#0b0b0b"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "#52514e", margin = margin(b = 12)),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 30, 10, 10),
  ) +
 theme(legend.position = "none")
  

library(forcats)

data |>
  select(-(er_otherreg_text)) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("reverse_"), names_to = "reverse", values_to = "value") |>
  filter(!is.na(regret_id)) |>
  filter(value > 1) |>
  mutate(strategy = case_when(
    reverse == "reverse_makeup"   ~ "Making up",
    reverse == "reverse_undo" ~ "Undoing",
    reverse == "reverse_plan" ~ "Planning",
    reverse == "reverse_amends" ~ "Making amends"
  )) |>
  count(strategy) |>
  mutate(strategy = fct_reorder(strategy, n)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = strategy, y = n)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = strategy), width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = scales::comma(n)),
    hjust = -0.15, size = 3.5, color = "#52514e"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12)),
    labels = scales::comma
  ) +
  coord_flip(clip = "off") +
  labs(
    title = "Behavior after a regrettable decision",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "#e1e0d9", linewidth = 0.3),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "#0b0b0b", size = 11),
    axis.text.x = element_text(color = "#898781"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(color = "#52514e"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, color = "#0b0b0b"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "#52514e", margin = margin(b = 12)),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 30, 10, 10),
  ) +
 theme(legend.position = "none")
  
```

# Suze archive

```{r}
df <- data %>%
  group_by(PID) %>%
  mutate(regret_intensity_pc = as.numeric(scale(regret_intensity, scale = FALSE))) %>%
  ungroup() # person-centering (?)

model_undo <- lmer(reverse_undo ~ regret_intensity_pc + (1 | PID), data = df) #failed to converge as (1 + [predictor] | PID)
tab_model(model_undo)
plot_model(model_undo)

model_makeup <- lmer(reverse_makeup ~ regret_intensity_pc + (1 | PID), data = df)
tab_model(model_makeup)
plot_model(model_makeup)

model_plan <- lmer(reverse_plan ~ regret_intensity_pc + (1 | PID), data = df)
tab_model(model_plan)
plot_model(model_plan)

model_amends <- lmer(reverse_amends ~ regret_intensity_pc + (1 | PID), data = df)
tab_model(model_amends)
plot_model(model_amends)

lm.beta.lmer <- function(mod) {
   b <- fixef(mod)[-1]
   sd.x <- apply(getME(mod,"X")[,-1],2,sd)
   sd.y <- sd(getME(mod,"y"))
   b*sd.x/sd.y
}      #is this model assuming we have at least one predictor?

lm.beta.lmer(model_undo)
lm.beta.lmer(model_makeup)
lm.beta.lmer(model_plan)
lm.beta.lmer(model_amends)
```

```{r}
# modeling time since the start of the episode within episodes

df <- df_ema_merged %>%
  filter(!is.na(regret_id), !is.na(regret_intensity), !is.na(recorded_date)) %>%
  arrange(PID, regret_id, recorded_date) %>%
  group_by(PID, regret_id) %>%
  mutate(time_since_start_min = as.numeric(difftime(recorded_date, min(recorded_date), units = "mins")),
    time_point = row_number(),
    initial_intensity = first(regret_intensity)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

df <- df %>%
  group_by(PID) %>%
  mutate(time_point_pc = as.numeric(scale(time_point, scale = FALSE)), time_minutes_pc = as.numeric(scale(time_since_start_min, scale = FALSE)), initial_intensity_pc = as.numeric(scale(initial_intensity, scale = FALSE))
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# regret_intensity ~ time
model_time <- lmer(regret_intensity ~ time_point_pc + (1 + time_point_pc | PID), data = df)

# regret_intensity ~ time + initial_intensity
model_time_initial <- lmer(regret_intensity ~ time_point_pc + initial_intensity_pc + (1 + time_point_pc | PID), data = df)

```
